name: Slideshow Curtain Zoom
description: Full-screen image slideshow driven by wheel, touch, drag or arrow buttons. Each change zooms and tilts the current slide while two curtain panels slide across, then the next slide zooms in.
contents: Two curtain panels that sweep during transitions
Hint text with previous and next round buttons
behavior: Wheel, touch and pointer gestures move to the next or previous slide, looping at the ends
Two-phase GSAP transition: current slide zooms and rotates under the curtains, then the next slide settles from zoomed to normal
Input is locked while a transition runs
Images are preloaded before the slideshow becomes visible
editableByProps: Background, curtain, text and button colors
Transition durations, easing, zoom and rotation
Wheel sensitivity, nav button visibility, size and hint text

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the curtain direction or number of curtain panels
Add captions or content over slides
needsCodeEdit.where: slidesRef map in the returned JSX

fixed: Fills the viewport height and captures wheel, touch and pointer gestures on its own area
